# stalwart_directory_ldap (Resource)

Defines an external directory for account authentication and lookups. Manages the LDAP Directory variant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stalwart_directory_ldap" "corporate" {
  description = "Corporate LDAP directory"
  url         = "ldaps://ldap.example.com:636"
  base_dn     = "dc=example,dc=com"
  bind_dn     = "cn=stalwart,ou=services,dc=example,dc=com"

  bind_secret = {
    type   = "Value"
    secret = var.ldap_bind_password
  }

  filter_login   = "(&(objectClass=posixAccount)(uid=?))"
  filter_mailbox = "(&(objectClass=posixAccount)(mail=?))"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_dn` (String) The base distinguished name (DN) from where searches should begin
- `description` (String) Short description of this directory

### Optional

- `allow_invalid_certs` (Boolean) Allow invalid TLS certificates when connecting to the server
- `attr_class` (Set of String) LDAP attribute for the user's account type, if missing defaults to individual.
- `attr_description` (Set of String) LDAP attributes used to store the user's description
- `attr_email` (Set of String) LDAP attribute for the user's primary email address
- `attr_email_alias` (Set of String) LDAP attribute for the user's email alias(es)
- `attr_member_of` (Set of String) LDAP attributes for the groups that a user belongs to. Used when filterMemberOf is not configured or when the group membership is also provided in the account entry.
- `attr_secret` (Set of String) LDAP attribute for the user's password hash. This setting is required when binding as a service user. When using bind authentication, configure the secret-changed attribute instead.
- `attr_secret_changed` (Set of String) LDAP attribute that provides a password change hash or a timestamp indicating when the password was last changed. When using bind authentication, this attribute is used to determine when to invalidate OAuth tokens.
- `bind_authentication` (Boolean) Whether to use bind authentication. When enabled, the server will use the filterLogin to search for the user account and then attempt to bind as that account using the provided password. When disabled, the server will use the bind DN and secret to connect to the LDAP server and obtain the secret from the account entry using the attrSecret attribute.
- `bind_dn` (String) The distinguished name of the account that the server will bind as to connect to the LDAP directory
- `bind_secret` (Attributes) The password or secret for the bind DN account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bind_secret))
- `filter_login` (String) Searches for user accounts by e-mail address during authentication
- `filter_mailbox` (String) Searches for users or groups matching a recipient e-mail address or alias
- `filter_member_of` (String) Searches for groups that an account is member of. Use when the group membership is not provided in the account entry. The ? in the filter will be replaced with the account DN.
- `group_class` (String) LDAP object class used to identify group entries
- `member_tenant_id` (String) Identifier for the tenant this directory belongs to Requires an Enterprise license.
- `pool_max_connections` (Number) Maximum number of connections that can be maintained simultaneously in the connection pool
- `pool_timeout_create` (Number) Maximum amount of time that the connection pool will wait for a new connection to be created
- `pool_timeout_recycle` (Number) Maximum amount of time that the connection pool manager will wait for a connection to be recycled
- `pool_timeout_wait` (Number) Maximum amount of time that the connection pool will wait for a connection to become available
- `timeout` (Number) Connection timeout to the server
- `url` (String) URL of the LDAP server
- `use_tls` (Boolean) Use TLS to connect to the remote server

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--bind_secret"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bind_secret`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stalwart_directory_ldap.corporate <id>
```
